newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS WEEK EASIER ON MOST UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS WEEK EASIER ON MOST UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar ended the week on Friday firmer on South Africa's rand but was quoted weaker against other hard currencies on the back of a last minute surge in import pressure, dealers said.

"A few payments were made towards the close of trade and the Reserve Bank was nowhere to be seen. I don't think they had enough time to map their strategy. We'll see what happens next week," one dealer said.

"But that volatility we witnessed last week seems to have gone after the Reserve Bank intervened to restore confidence in the market early this week. We're still bearish but at manageable levels," he added.
The local unit closed on Friday at 10.6000/6200 against the U.S. dollar compared to Thursday's 10.5850/6050 and was also easier at 16.9300/9700 against sterling from 16.8420/8840.
It was at 6.9580/9750 from 6.9510/9680 against the mark but edged up to 2.2970/3040 from 2.3070/3140 versus the ailing rand.
